description: Reviews API: List App Store reviews. Reviews of an app in one country's App Store as `Review` objects, newest or most helpful first. Apple publishes the newest 500 reviews per country and sort: `meta.complete` is false when that cap cut the list. `meta.entity` is the app. A page that returns nothing only because of the filters, with `has_more` true, is free. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

app_id.description: App Store app ID or bundle ID

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 50, one page of the source)

name: reviews_appstore_app_reviews
title: List App Store reviews
